kind: Author-team continuation audit and corrections; not independent acceptance

findings.issue: A stale page wrote its complete progress snapshot, replacing a completed save from another page.
findings.fix: prepareSave refuses a changed stored snapshot, leaving in-page edits available to Export. The fallback exposes the saved text observed at conflict for separate recovery. README requires one editing tab and distinguishes detection from atomic locking.
findings.limit: Eight pure data tests and syntax checks; actual DOM, Storage and simultaneous cross-tab behavior remain browser-unverified. Compare-before-write is not a transaction.

findings.issue: A raw URL substring guard could accept a production database when the course name appeared in a username, password or query parameter.
findings.fix: Parse effective SQLx options, require exact documented database and local transport, and verify current_database() on each pooled connection before migrations or resets. A reusable fixture runner creates private Unix-socket-only PostgreSQL16 storage and removes only that owned cluster after successful stop.
findings.limit: A name and loopback transport are not ownership evidence. Existing databases are not to be reset solely because their names match. Six guard test entries and four opt-in integration tests ran; no existing database was contacted.

findings.issue: Waiting only for watch.changed() misses an initially true shutdown state, treats false notifications as stop, and the CLI detached its signal watcher.
findings.fix: Inspect current state before each wait, stop on true or closed sender, retain the same server future while observing Ctrl-C, and drain connection tasks on shutdown or accept errors.
findings.limit: Ten scoped chat tests include two new shutdown regressions. The final baseline must include the subsequent common cleanup on accept-error change. Two-second test deadlines detect hangs, not service latency promises.

primary_sources.supports: Web Storage shared state does not promise cross-agent locking.
